head_commit.message: fix(ci): prepare external runtime hosts serially
fix(release): record authorized root selections
fix(release): use qualified backport execution

test(topology): stagger isolated session startup

Keep both sessions live for routing, state, cross-call rejection and
peer-disposal proofs without overlapping every cold host startup.
Preserve all readiness checks and their existing timeout budgets.

fix: keep the catalog import contract for release ci

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

build(release): restore approved dependency selection

Retain the reviewed release tree while exact-source CI completes.

ci: record selected root gitlinks for release

Authorize the committed pointers that differ from v1.4.0 so the
publication gitlink gate can proceed. Selection only.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix(build): inherit patched security versions from catalog

Remove redundant package overrides now supplied by the pinned Builds catalog.
SignalR.Common, Options and DI.Abstractions remain at 10.0.13.

fix: isolate stateless test sidecar components

Give stateless Dapr sidecars an SDK-owned component directory.
Prevent implicit loading of shared developer Redis components.

ci: refresh release dependency evidence

Align live source receipts with committed root gitlinks and the current
FrontComposer status markup. Record the authorized release selections.

fix(ui): restore localized container startup

Enable culture support in the UI runtime and select the Alpine image
with ICU so request localization can start on both container platforms.

Honor project container settings while preserving shared defaults.

fix(release): enable NuGet trusted publishing

Use the shared preparation action in the Parties production job so
NuGet can validate the workflow identity and issue a temporary key.

Reconcile current EventStore and Memories selections while keeping
historical validation receipts bound to their original commits.

fix: isolate semantic search performance tests

Run semantic and local fuzzy search benchmarks in the existing
non-parallel collection to avoid contention with other test classes.
Keep the 500 ms performance gate and all result assertions.

fix: restore package-mode builds and release gates

Select EventStore 3.115.0 and retain Parties validation and redaction
through the SDK async processor path. Reconcile current dependency
checks with the dated migration receipts and release signoff ledger.

Configure symmetric JWT in the test topology and report infrastructure
unavailability explicitly instead of returning a silent gateway pass.

fix: rebind container provenance labels after SDK parse

.NET SDK 10 splits label values on colon, so image.source
becomes https and OCI validation rejects the published index.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix: accept commitlint proof in release preflight

Bypass-validation selects commitlint.yml, but the Parties
publication wrapper still required ci.yml and blocked 1.1.0.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix: grant release caller governed job permissions

GitHub rejects domain-release.yml at startup unless the caller
declares id-token and attestations for the skipped governed job.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix: refresh live Hexalith identity pins

Align EventStore and FrontComposer source receipts with HEAD
gitlinks, and match Epic 8 tracker status so push CI can pass
after the catalog adopt.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
